role: One fixed economic necessary-condition screen, not a trading backtest or candidate admission. Counts as the batch's sole economic attempt. No second economic experiment after this screen.
domain: 2024 development,52equal-block-bin midpoint samples across the entire UTC year; not every minute, every trade opportunity or an independent confirmation.
fee_definition: Existing project's reference taker benchmark:2*10bpsspot+2*5.5bpshedge, stress2x. Fixed flat budget per input ETH, not verified historical account fees or a mathematical lower bound for every USD path. Pool fee/size impact already in get_dy; not double counted.
redemption_leg_bound: If immediately requesting withdrawal of q received stETH, redeemable ETH is at most q (rounding only reduces); gross ETH headroom upper=10000*(q/input-1). Zero gas,zero wait opportunity cost,zero slashing andzero adverse execution deliberately favor the mechanism. No staking rewards during request. Outputs are quote/claim capacity, not actual execution or USD net PnL.
excluded_other_returns: ETH directional gain and perpetual funding are not redemption discount alpha; they are NOT asserted nonpositive. This screen cannot bound total hedged USD PnL, liquidation risk or mark-to-market NAV. Positive funding could offset costs but would need a separate validated strategy, not a covert reopening of failed funding carry.
risk_and_exit: No funded or simulated position is opened.8percenthardstop/max50percentnotional remain unchanged but are NOT evaluated. No terminal NAV,Sharpe,DD,annualized return or G4 claim permitted. Transferable withdrawal NFT does not establish a liquid stop-loss exit.
decision: If no fixed sample has gross headroom strictly above31bps,REJECT_SAMPLED_REFERENCE_COST_COVERAGE. Else if none above62bps,INSUFFICIENT_STRESS_COST_HEADROOM. Otherwise,COST_HEADROOM_PRESENT_EXIT_MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED. Every branch selects0qualifiedcandidates; positive headroom never establishes profitability. No missing quote may be dropped or replaced.
transport: ExistinglocalreadonlyAlchemy; chainIdonce, then52serial6-methodPOSTs.15sconnect/30stotal,2MiBresponse,1secondminimumstartspacing,0automaticretries/redirects/cloud. Each RPCmethod counts. Unknown failure stops dependent work.
